nodes.label: Prisma Management API Conventions
nodes.rationale: Shared conventions (base URL, data envelope, ID prefixes, cursor pagination, error shapes) across all three prisma-postgres-* skills.

nodes.label: Management API Resource ID Prefixes
nodes.rationale: Every resource ID carries a type prefix (proj_, db_, con_, wksp_); omitting the prefix causes resource-not-found (404) errors on API requests.
